verdict.rationale: Text content was extracted from floridarevenue.com guidance pages (the reemployment tax page, the eServices login guidance page and the homepage), so a pipeline reached real readable text rather than a JS-only shell or CAPTCHA. Probe-3 calls the floridarevenue.com guidance 'open' and recorded an HTTP 200 for the standard pipeline UA on the related taxapps host. The 404s on llms.txt and the .md variant are ordinary not-found replies, not bot challenges. missing for 10: an explicit probe recording HTTP 200 for a guidance page itself under an identified UA, and confirmation of consistent no-challenge behavior across the guidance site.
